title: Module 15 quiz — BayOps AI
description: Eight questions on summarization, evidence vs hypothesis, runbooks, human approval, hallucination. Synthetic BayPay.

questions.prompt: Which four sections must every BayOps response contain?
choices: Severity, owner, Slack channel, and Jira key
Evidence, hypotheses, recommended investigation, and suggested remediation
Proven RCA, blast radius, customer list, and a force-push
Bedrock model id, token count, cost, and region
questions.explanation: BAYOPS.md locks the four buckets. A proven RCA field fails the contract.

questions.prompt: A hypothesis that fits the opened files should be marked how?
choices: proven
unproven (until more gates confirm or weaken it)
auto-approved
rootCause=true
questions.explanation: AI is an investigator. Status stays unproven, weakened, or withdrawn.

questions.prompt: What must happen before a mutating remediation runs?
choices: The model sets humanApproval to approved by itself
A named human (Riley or Priya in the teaching story) writes approved or rejected
Lambda retries three times
Someone force-pushes main
questions.explanation: Human approval is first-class. Auto-approve is a failed lab.

questions.prompt: A BayOps JSON cites evidence/db-failover.json, but that file is not in the pack. What is that?
choices: A successful retrieval-augmented generation
An unsupported / hallucinated citation — fail the output
Proof that Postgres failed over
A reason to bounce dmgr-east
questions.explanation: AI-1504 class: invented files are not evidence.

questions.prompt: Which runbook action should Priya reject on sight for payment-service on Fargate?
choices: Open the next gated evidence file
Bounce dmgr-east / PaymentCluster or disable TLS to restore merchants
Leave humanApproval pending while quoting ALB health
Ask Jordan not to push another tag
questions.explanation: Leftover ND is not the estate. Disabling TLS is not a stabilize.

questions.prompt: Is a live Amazon Bedrock call required to pass Module 15?
choices: Yes; otherwise the schema is invalid
No; paper fixtures and the JSON contract are the grade bar
Yes; and you must apply EKS for the vector store
Yes; NAT Gateway is required for Lambda
questions.explanation: Live model is optional extra credit with cost and cleanup.

questions.prompt: What must never be sent to a model or stored in a BayOps fixture?
choices: correlationId and paymentId
PAN, CVV, or BAYPAY_DB_PASSWORD
The word unproven
The service name payment-service
questions.explanation: Synthetic ops data only. Secrets and card data stay out.

questions.prompt: Staff scoring: a student writes “the AI is wrong” with no quotes. What happens to Diagnostic method?
choices: It maxes because the title said hallucination
It does not max — they must quote the invented file and the proven-RCA field
They automatically pass if Bedrock was down
They must bounce Postgres to confirm
questions.explanation: Lucky label is not method. AI-1504 rubric.
